---
title: "Aqueous amine fit replays on wheel S"
---

The five reported designs were replayed on the Engine 1.3.1 wheel pinned in
`uv.lock` at the selected parameter fingerprints. The reaction reference
pressure was 100 kPa. Each objective is half the sum of squared weighted
residuals over the fitted observations.

| Design | Fitted rows available | Retained objective | Replayed objective | Difference | Printed objective |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| [MEA](results/mea/reported/replay/endpoint.json.gz) | 307/307 | 152.9324022812434 | 152.9324022812434 | 0 | 152.932402 |
| [DEA](results/dea/reported/replay/endpoint.json.gz) | 140/140 | 15.58866708642742 | 15.58866708642742 | 0 | 15.588667 |
| [MDEA](results/mdea/reported/replay/endpoint.json.gz) | 281/281 | 15.609314353577124 | 15.609314353577124 | 0 | 15.609314 |
| [AMP, fitted slope](results/amp/reported/replay/endpoint.json.gz) | 214/214 | 74.92815817501189 | 74.92815817501189 | 0 | 74.928158 |
| [AMP, fixed slope](results/amp/fixed-slope/replay/endpoint.json.gz) | 214/214 | 76.22656354502179 | 76.22656354502179 | 0 | 76.226564 |

Every fitted-row record was identical to its retained counterpart. All fitted
derivatives were available. The linked files contain the individual
predictions, residuals, derivative diagnostics and conditional uncertainty.
The replay verifies reproduction at the saved parameters. Refit selection,
phase classification and agreement with independent measurements require
separate evidence.

At the retained MEA endpoint, the dense-grid case at 313.15 K, 15 mass %
MEA, and 10⁻⁵ mol CO₂/mol MEA reproduced the retained bubble pressure
of 6,987.98 Pa and the same completed native search with no
resolved descent at 1.05 times that pressure. The loaded-liquid density for
`Amundsen2009_state_060` at 298.15 K was 1,029.44 kg/m³, equal
to the retained prediction. These are numerical checks of the two paths.

## Reproduction from a staged copy on wheel S

The staged calculations used the locked S wheel, verified against the archive
and installed bytes, with three cores per job. The scratch staging copied the
package and its retained inputs and used the package functions for the refits
and native searches. The scratch inventory needed the historical MEA
endpoint-only-coordinates.json and MDEA stage-b.toml. The Stage 0 check also
carried the binary-hull functions into the scratch copy. The fixed-reference
fits retain the 100 kPa reaction reference and the objective defined above.

The sodium-salt cascade reproduced the parameter document, all 145 retained
observations and refusals, and all three fitted objectives exactly. The mixed
assessment had 39 available rows out of 45. The regenerated water–bicarbonate
and water–carbonate coefficients matched the original MEA start.

With the recorded controls applied, each of the five reported amine fits
selected A. The complete parameter documents, fingerprints, objectives and
fitted predictions matched exactly. The computed derivative fields shared
with the retained diagnostics also matched. The package additionally writes
the projected gradient on the optimizer scale. The
[refit comparison](results/shared/preservation/refits.json.gz) holds the
selected fingerprints, exact objectives and full-precision differences for the
alternate starts.

| Fit | Selected objective | Fitted rows available | Staged time (s) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| MEA | 152.932402 | 307/307 | 501.60, plus 234.15 for LHS-21 at the recorded limit |
| DEA | 15.588667 | 140/140 | 321.37 |
| AMP, fitted slope | 74.928158 | 214/214 | 255.56, plus 151.99 for LHS-45 at the recorded limits |
| AMP, fixed slope | 76.226564 | 214/214 | 151.48, plus 60.14 to verify LHS-53 at its recorded limit |
| MDEA | 15.609314 | 281/281 | 998.46 for A, 13.63 for B and C, and 467.70 for LHS-53 at the recorded limits |

All 40 [staged endpoint replays](results/shared/preservation/replays.json.gz)
reproduced the numerical content of the S baseline. The MEA system-pressure
record also emitted an explicit count of 307 available rows and an empty
prediction-difference list. The replays took 1,260.67 s. With the ten replay
records it reads directly replaced, the display check reproduced 55 tables
and 16 figures in 20.83 s. The other display inputs were held at their
retained values for this comparison. The earlier campaign records for DEA
#413 candidate 1 and the unbounded MDEA bicarbonate 0.765 case differ by at
most 9.44 × 10⁻¹³ and 2.02 × 10⁻¹² relative in their predictions. The bounded
MDEA case differs in objective by −2.66 × 10⁻¹¹. These differences were
already recorded at A2 and leave the printed values unchanged.

The original package refit used common time limits where the attempt records
declared individual limits. The refit now reads the limits from each
attempt and continuation record. With those controls, the same S wheel
produced three changes to alternate-start endpoints.

| Alternate start | Retained and staged comparison | Printed changes |
|---|---|---|
| MEA LHS-21 | At 187.5 s the first stage stopped after 87 of the original 93 cost entries. All 87 matched. The continuation changed the endpoint. | 62. The projected gradient changed from 2.648 × 10⁻⁵ to 3.957 × 10⁻⁵. This changed the prose minimum and 60 pressure and heat spread cells. |
| AMP LHS-45, fitted slope | At 88.95 s the first stage stopped after 44 of the original 55 cost entries. All 44 matched. The 40 s continuation started from that point. | Five. The projected gradient changed from 2.298 × 10⁻⁴ to 2.218 × 10⁻⁴, along with four Kundu and Tong pressure spread cells. |
| MDEA LHS-53 | The preceding endpoint and all 41 cost entries were exact. In the 75 s continuation, the first new refusal occurred at trial 10 when the Merkley saturation calculation exhausted its work budget. The trust-region radius reached 7.52 × 10⁻³³ against the 10⁻³² minimum. | Two. The objective changed from 48,386.509423 to 48,387.293467. The outcome lost the parameter-tolerance label. |

The 351 MEA, 56 AMP and 307 MDEA assessment rows retained their identities
and availability, with the same refusal causes. A was selected in all three
cases. The
[printed comparison](results/shared/preservation/printed-differences.json)
identifies every changed cell or value in the elapsed-limit run. These were
Class 1 differences. The subsequent [cost-entry comparison](results/shared/preservation/fit-cost-budgets.json.gz)
reproduced the MEA fingerprint in 93 cost entries and the free-slope AMP
fingerprint in two stages of 55 and 24 entries. The two reruns recovered the
original projected gradients and assessments exactly and took 253.00 s and
176.07 s.

Removing the 75 s limit from the MDEA continuation matched the first 16 of
its 23 retained cost entries. The 17th entry in the retained history refused
the Merkley saturation search after its elapsed work budget ran out. The
trace first records the exhausted deadline at 0.65 mol CO2 per mol MDEA
for `fit:125`. The count-budgeted run accepted that iteration at
`48386.2670314497` and ended at objective `48386.22158304294` after 643.15 s
including the first stage. A diagnostic rerun from the exact first-stage
endpoint stopped at the end of the 16-entry common prefix in 173.45 s,
recovering the retained objective `48386.50942301494`, fingerprint,
projected gradient and all 307 assessment predictions exactly. The fresh
diagnostic stopped at its iteration budget. The manuscript reports the
historical attempt's elapsed time limit as a Class 3 correction. The
historical parameter-tolerance label resulted from the rejected steps
after the deadline. Start A remains selected. Owner decision 2 calls for
restarting this draw on W under M5. In the
separate MDEA descent continuation, the objective changed from
15.609312497421323 to 15.609312502021526. Both print as 15.60931 and the
comparison changed no printed cell. The 13 bounded descent probes and
the four MDEA projected-direction trials matched the retained numerical
records. Their staged runs took 194.72 s and 64.03 s, respectively.

| Phase population | Requested keys matched | Search-class or numeric differences | Staged time (s) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| MEA grid | 2,484 | 0 | 164.41 |
| DEA native | 1,271 | 0 | 92.77 |
| AMP native, both slopes | 1,332 | 0 | 82.02 |

The property-observation replay matched all 1,570 DEA, AMP and MDEA row
identities, availability classes and numeric values. The MEA path now records
the solved temperatures for the 25 boiling-temperature and vapor-composition
pairs. Its 307 fitted property rows matched every retained prediction, and
the paired solved temperatures spanned 363.18–433.75 K.

The MDEA slope-bound declaration, the replay of A with all 281 rows available,
and all 137 hull cases matched their retained records. At 288.71 K and
1.466 MPa the MDEA–water gap-onset bracket was reproduced at
−0.1328280448913574 ≤ k ≤ −0.13282737731933592. The 64 regenerated draws
reproduced all 17,984 census statuses, with 17,363 available rows,
612 central-solve refusals and nine action refusals. The census took 741.17 s.
The independent tight-tolerance probe used `fit:0`. With the
declared tolerance of 10⁻¹⁰, the solve attained 7.11 × 10⁻¹⁴.
At the tighter request of 4.44 × 10⁻¹⁵, S returned CentralSolveUnavailable
at the 200-iteration work limit with residual 1.11. A second probe made
63 tighter requests across 21 retained rows. It yielded 53 available
predictions that met the tighter tolerances, nine central-solve refusals and
one action refusal. Holding the admitted solve fixed and lowering the
requested tolerance to the next representable value below its attained
residual changed the census classification from Available to
ToleranceNotMet. This was a classification check on the held response.

The MDEA state `comparison:157:problem` at 293.15 K and 0.5 MPa
reproduced the unavailable optimized result and the supplied trial's
dimensionless TPD/RT of −0.9718818375750402. The trial evaluated an
existing composition on a separately solved liquid parent. Across the
11,824 reported MDEA requests, 10,509 were available. The 80 detections
comprised eight from available optimized searches and 72 from supplied
trials whose optimized searches were unavailable. The 80 detections
resolved to 27 distinct states. None of the 27 split checks confirmed
two liquids. The rebuilt DEA screen reproduced all six split confirmations.
All 20 fixed-pressure DEA, AMP and MDEA controls retained their classifications.

The separate MEA measured-pressure run reproduced 246 available results
among 321 requests at the original closure rule, with no resolved descent.
Its 162-state flash census reproduced 149 two-phase parents and 13
single-liquid parents. Applying the newer density-scaled pressure criterion
would admit 75 additional measured-pressure parents on the same wheel.
For example, at 313.15 K and 101,325 Pa, the parent of
`Jakobsen2005_state_022::MEACOO-` has a pressure mismatch of
3.3213 × 10⁻⁵ Pa. Dividing by the requested pressure gives 3.2778 × 10⁻¹⁰.
Dividing by the molar density times RT gives 2.8540 × 10⁻¹³. The former
misses the 10⁻¹⁰ gate and the latter passes it. The staged rerun used
the original criterion for this preserved population.

The [phase comparison](results/shared/preservation/phase-comparison.json)
records the held-response classifications, request comparisons and
re-solves by set. The historical MEA restrictions grid and the full MDEA
bicarbonate 0.765 screen lack per-state responses and support request
comparison only. The separate restrictions census and the 27 measured MDEA
records do hold responses. The DEA MEA-fitted shared summaries and the AMP
F2 probes also lack complete per-state responses. The eight AMP probe
counts were independently reproduced on S. The phase evidence checks
the calculation paths at retained parameters and conditions.

The regenerated display curves matched all 2,211 MEA, 275 DEA and 483 MDEA
rows by identity, status and plotted quantity. The Hong 30 mass % MEA model
reproduced the stability labels at all 90 weight nodes, with 62 locally
unstable and 28 stable. Its three independent fugacity checks and five
finite-difference Hessian checks matched the retained records.

The 14 C1 Gibbs-derivative records reproduced their displayed quantities
using the procedures that originally generated them. A first staged run
with the later scaled pressure-closure gate changed step admission in
six records. The preservation comparison restored the original
pressure basis and the reclosure procedures for the rebuilt MEA and DEA
cases. The comparison used the direct pressure gate for the two AMP
records. The six AMP control candidate flags also reproduced after
restoring the original liquid–vapor root qualification. At 373.00 K
and 0.510 MPa, the candidate for Hartono row 10 has the same calculated
Gibbs energy under both gates. The original gate rejects the vapor root
because Engine S returned its identity as unspecified.

The display check over regenerated phase and property records,
the derivative summary, and the count-budgeted MEA and AMP fits
reproduced 55 tables and 16 figures when the MDEA LHS-53 cell used the
historical termination record. With the Class 3 correction, the cell
reports the historical time limit.

The second display correction pass on S traced the admitted step count
to all 16 volume and 16 enthalpy checks. Each admitted two or three steps.
The fitted-state tracking-reference corrections span −37.0 to −29.0 %
of the equation-of-state volume across the four amine records.

The retained first-data AMP endpoint has 73 confirmed splits, at
26.8–30.0 wt % AMP. Its largest confirmed decrease in $G/(RT)$ is
0.01881 mol, against a numerical error of $2.8 \times 10^{-9}$ mol,
at 393.15 K, 30.0 wt % AMP, 0.700 mol/mol loading and 1.212 MPa.
These values describe the numerical equilibrium comparison.
The same cross-check distinguishes six historical confirmations from
the six measured-pressure controls evaluated at the reported AMP
endpoint. The latter have four vapor-directed outcomes (three Hartono,
one Tong) and two without a resolved descent.

## Neutral-property endpoints

AMP values agree exactly for 50 pure-component rows, 26 bubble-pressure
rows and 26 vapor-composition rows at each of the two binary endpoints.
The [replay record](results/amp/pure-and-binary/replay/endpoint.json.gz)
gives cohort AARD, signed relative bias and the pure density deviations.

The retained DEA neutral campaign was recorded on build 391dfe5d. The
saved interaction and permittivity parameters were applied to the same
measurements on S. All 25 pure pressures, 44 binary pressures and 30
permittivity rows were available. The ideal-gas heat capacity readback subtracts the model's residual heat
capacity at 100 kPa from the measured liquid values before fitting the
temperature line. The replay reproduces both line coefficients
exactly. Differences in the bubble objective and permittivity deviation
are below printing precision. The
[replay record](results/dea/water-binary/replay/endpoint.json.gz)
preserves the individual rows.

## Archive populations outside the display and move comparisons

- AMP first-data, both slopes. The prose bindings in dea_displays.py
  use cost and original.rows. The expanded role assignment at those
  same two endpoints belongs to the round-5 campaign record. The display
  mapping names the separate broadened AMP endpoints for the comparison.
- MEA expanded weights. final_rerun_tables.py reads the F4 and incumbent
  off-window records and objective families. The F2 off-window rows and
  historical-F2 expanded control were used by the round-7 campaign
  handoff. The mapped display families have no read of either control.
- MEA restrictions. The choice table uses the fitted pressures and
  densities and the 112 assessment pressures at each endpoint. The F2
  published and temperature-band comparisons additionally use the Wagner
  and transfer pressures. The other restriction arms' analogous cohorts
  have no separate mapped comparison.
- MEA electrostatics. The carbonate-share table and its prose use the
  14 entries of CCASES in dea_displays.py. The two displayed refits
  use M3 and P1. S1, P0-refit, the 2.9296 Å bicarbonate and 2.4422 Å
  carbonate Born arms and the two 3 Å controls stay in the campaign
  archive.

## MDEA descents by search availability

At the provisional MDEA endpoint on S, 10,509 of 11,824 phase searches have an
available result. Eight of those searches recorded a descent.
Supplied trial compositions establish 72 further descents at requests whose
optimized result was unavailable. These counts describe the finite set of
model calculations. They give no experimental determination of the phase
state.

The [phase summary](results/shared/phase/display-summary.json.gz) records the
classes as `mdea_descent_counts.optimized_result_available` and
`mdea_descent_counts.supplied_trial_optimized_result_unavailable`. They are
derived from `rows[].descent`, `rows[].available`, `rows[].optimized_available`
and `rows[].supplied_available` in the
[selected screen](../fixed_reaction_reference/results/MDEA/screen/selected/declared/summary.json.gz).
The main text and supplement each attribute all 80 descents to finished
searches. The A3 wording review records both sentences and their component
counts in [findings.jsonl](findings.jsonl). The same screen records 10,742
completed requests. Completion, optimization availability and a supplied
descent describe different numerical outcomes.

## Kuranov row 72 by reaction reference

The unfitted row at 393.16 K has a measured total pressure of 1.205300 MPa.
The [system-pressure-reference calculation](../round_7/results/display-replays/kuranov-row-72.json.gz)
gives 1.165620 MPa, the value printed in the supplement. The
[reported endpoint with the 100 kPa references](../fixed_reaction_reference/results/MDEA/property-comparisons/A.json.gz)
gives 1.164098 MPa for the same observation on S, which is now the value
bound in the supplement. The two calculations change the endpoint and the
reaction references together.


## Reported MEA property and uncertainty replay on S

The [reported MEA summary](results/mea/reported/properties/uncertainty-and-activities.json.gz)
holds the numerical replay at the 100 kPa reaction-reference endpoint. All
213 retained activity requests and eight carbonate-pool requests returned
results. Repeating the activity calculation at the historical F4 endpoint
first reproduced all 213 retained pH values and all eight pool fractions.
On the reported endpoint the maximum calculated carbonate-pool fraction
is 0.065 at the manuscript's precision. For the 197 matched electrode
observations, the reported endpoint minus electrode difference ranges from
−0.149 to +0.138 pH units, with a mean of +0.005. The pressure and electrode
basis limitations stated in the supplement still apply.

The 25 Cai temperatures and 25 vapor fractions contribute 39.750 and
51.796 to the dimensionless objective of 152.932, a combined 59.86%.
The variance factor using the 268 responsive rows and nine free coordinates
is 1.181 at the printed precision. The standard-error ratio to the
all-row variance basis is 1.07264814. The conditional relative standard
errors on the 47 fitted partial pressures span 5.94274–17.00638%.
The calculation holds the bounds and weights fixed and omits model
discrepancy and correlation uncertainty. These are checks of the reported
endpoint and its conditional covariance.

The replay is generated from the fit, Jacobian and retained state feeds with
`uv run --locked python -c 'from analyses.amines.mea import write_reported_property_summary; write_reported_property_summary()'`.
The [binding ledger](findings.jsonl) carries the remaining wording findings
for the manuscript revision on W.
